topic: How does the hierarchical classification framework impact satellite link budget margins when prioritizing QoS-sensitive traffic?
consensus_response: Satellite links suffer from high latency and limited bandwidth due to fixed bandwidth and interference. This hinders accurate path selection and resource allocation, making dynamic routing approaches crucial for efficient QoS provision.  Adaptive modulation techniques like higher-order modulations are essential to mitigate spectral efficiency loss caused by interference. Dynamic routing algorithms that adapt to varying network conditions can further optimize link utilization and prioritize sensitive applications even with high latency.
reference_context: Satellite links face challenges due to fixed bandwidth, leading to interference and signal distortion. This impacts array factor optimization (antenna positioning) and necessitates higher-order modulations for spectral efficiency. Dynamic routing algorithms are crucial for adapting to varying network conditions and prioritizing QoS sensitive traffic even with high latency.
